business_objective.customer_problem: Pelanggan dan mitra memerlukan katalog apparel on-demand yang transparan, mudah diorder via WhatsApp/web, dan mendukung promo/diskon fleksibel tanpa friksi.
business_objective.commercial_necessity: Founder memerlukan kontrol penuh atas penetapan harga jual, promo bundling, penghitungan HPP otomatis per unit, dan transparansi laba bersih riil untuk mencapai target transisi finansial Rp 2.500.000/bulan.

measurable_metrics: Zero hardcoded prices in client/server code; pricing fully governed by database/admin rules
Dynamic HPP calculation on every order (blank garment + DTF print area + packaging + overhead)
Real-time net profit realization per order and monthly cumulative dashboard for founder
Automated inventory reservation preventing overselling on blank shirts and raw materials
Flexible promo engine supporting vouchers, bundling discounts, and wholesale tiering
desired_outcome.expected_founder_impact: Founder memiliki visibilitas finansial penuh terhadap keuntungan bersih harian dan fleksibilitas penuh mengatur strategi harga/promo tanpa ketergantungan edit kode.

owner_direction.decision_reference: Owner explicit directive: flexible pricing, full ERP features (inventory, HPP, net profit, promo engine), trilateral handoff from ORION to ATLAS

customer_experience.primary_user_journey: Pelanggan membuka katalog /shop atau PDP /shop/[slug] yang menampilkan harga aktif dan promo, memilih warna/ukuran, dan menyelesaikan order via WhatsApp Assisted Intake dengan rincian promo otomatis.
visible_acceptance_criteria: Harga tampil dinamis sesuai aturan promo aktif tanpa hardcoded price di frontend
Kode voucher atau diskon bundling otomatis memotong subtotal belanja
Format pesan WhatsApp terisi lengkap dengan rincian harga, diskon, dan total akhir
operational_acceptance_criteria: Setiap order mengunci snapshot HPP dan mengalkulasi laba bersih riil
Stok bahan blank otomatis teralokasi (reserved) saat order masuk
Founder dapat melihat rekap laba bersih harian di dashboard admin MGBOS

in_scope: Dynamic pricing table and promo engine schema in MGBOS Supabase
Dynamic HPP (COGS) calculation based on Bill of Materials (BOM)
Inventory stock reservation and tracking for blanks and raw materials
Net profit snapshot calculation per order
Frontend integration in apps/teestock to pull dynamic prices and format WhatsApp orders with active promos
out_of_scope: Direct external credit card payment gateway onboarding (focus remains on QRIS and WhatsApp assisted intake)
Automated physical cutting and sewing garment manufacturing
non_goals: Forcing fixed or hardcoded retail prices in the repository

financial_constraints: Net profit must be strictly calculated with immutable snapshots per order
Zero negative margin orders without explicit founder promotional override
security_boundaries: RLS must protect internal HPP breakdown and profit margins from unauthorized public disclosure
Public client only reads active retail prices and public promos, never raw supplier costs
operational_constraints: Inventory allocations must be atomic to prevent race conditions during concurrent orders
Single-writer constraint applies to Builder implementation

known_unknowns: Daftar pasti kode voucher awal yang diinginkan Founder saat peluncuran
Pilihan nominal fee payment gateway (jika ada add-on QRIS dinamis di masa depan)
priority_rationale: Memberikan infrastruktur ERP dan fleksibilitas harga penuh kepada Founder agar dapat langsung jualan dengan berbagai strategi harga dan memantau laba bersih harian secara akurat.
